segment.source: Use the western dock. Everythin' else is off-limits.<end>
segment.target: Use the western dock. Everythin' else is off-limits.<end>

segment.source: Yer late. Get movin' and unload the stuff. Just unload it here on the dock and our workers will bring it in. Don't go wanderin' off unless yer lookin' for trouble, ya dig?<end>
segment.target: Yer late. Get movin' and unload the stuff. Just unload it here on the dock and our workers will bring it in. Don't go wanderin' off unless yer lookin' for trouble, ya dig?<end>

segment.source: Um, what do you mean by "wanderin' off"?<end>
segment.target: Um, what do you mean by "wanderin' off"?<end>

segment.source: Are ya stupid or what? Everythin' but this dock is off-limits. *Off-limits*. That means ya get shot if we find ya snoopin' around. Ya dig now?<end>
segment.target: Are ya stupid or what? Everythin' but this dock is off-limits. *Off-limits*. That means ya get shot if we find ya snoopin' around. Ya dig now?<end>

segment.source: What if I need to take a leak?<end>
segment.target: What if I need to take a leak?<end>

segment.source:
What the-- Then take it in yer pants, dammit! I don't give a rat's. With the kind of raids the pirates've been pullin' off lately, we ain't takin' chances with anythin' or anyone. For all I know, there could be a band of 'em hidin' in that container right there, ready to slice my throat wide open.
Just... just keep to this dock, $(#jack/sis), and we're cool. Dig?<end>
segment.target:
What the-- Then take it in yer pants, dammit! I don't give a rat's. With the kind of raids the pirates've been pullin' off lately, we ain't takin' chances with anythin' or anyone. For all I know, there could be a band of 'em hidin' in that container right there, ready to slice my throat wide open.
Just... just keep to this dock, $(#jack/sis), and we're cool. Dig?<end>

segment.source: I'm not looking for trouble: I'm bringing trouble. ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: I'm not looking for trouble: I'm bringing trouble. ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source: I got my eyes on ya.<end>
segment.target: I got my eyes on ya.<end>

segment.source: Keep yer hands where I can see 'em.<end>
segment.target: Keep yer hands where I can see 'em.<end>

segment.source: If I see ya doin' anythin' suspicious...<end>
segment.target: If I see ya doin' anythin' suspicious...<end>

segment.source: Yer on Black Eel territory now, $(#jack/sis).<end>
segment.target: Yer on Black Eel territory now, $(#jack/sis).<end>

segment.source: Make sure to visit the tavern.<end>
segment.target: Make sure to visit the tavern.<end>

segment.source: If ya need somethin' for yer jet: Boulder's Jet Bits. Right by the tavern.<end>
segment.target: If ya need somethin' for yer jet: Boulder's Jet Bits. Right by the tavern.<end>

segment.source: Murky, the tavern keeper, also sells ammo if ya need some.<end>
segment.target: Murky, the tavern keeper, also sells ammo if ya need some.<end>

segment.source: If I catch ya fiddlin' with anyone's jet...<end>
segment.target: If I catch ya fiddlin' with anyone's jet...<end>

segment.source: The recent pirate raid was just an isolated incident. These waters still belong to us.<end>
segment.target: The recent pirate raid was just an isolated incident. These waters still belong to us.<end>

segment.source: We're already makin' the stinkin' pirates pay for Armstrong. We're killin' them by the dozens.<end>
segment.target: We're already makin' the stinkin' pirates pay for Armstrong. We're killin' them by the dozens.<end>

segment.source: What are ya waitin' for? Advance payment?<end>
segment.target: What are ya waitin' for? Advance payment?<end>

segment.source: Come on, we ain't got all day!<end>
segment.target: Come on, we ain't got all day!<end>

segment.source: Who're you? Ya ain't supposed to be 'ere.<end>
segment.target: Who're you? Ya ain't supposed to be 'ere.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Came here to figure out why the system's been running slow lately.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Came here to figure out why the system's been running slow lately.<end>

segment.source: Uh... Yeah. Mike'll be 'ere shortly to give ya a hand. He's the one workin' with the thing. He, uh... went to rest 'is eyes.<end>
segment.target: Uh... Yeah. Mike'll be 'ere shortly to give ya a hand. He's the one workin' with the thing. He, uh... went to rest 'is eyes.<end>

segment.source: Let the man rest: I'm here.<end>
segment.target: Let the man rest: I'm here.<end>

segment.source: Yeah, alright. Should be back soon anyway.<end>
segment.target: Yeah, alright. Should be back soon anyway.<end>

segment.source: Oh, and... could you please get me a cold brew? Helps my brain do them calculations right. Thanks.<end>
segment.target: Oh, and... could you please get me a cold brew? Helps my brain do them calculations right. Thanks.<end>

segment.source: ::He raises his weapon.:: Thought ya could fool me, punk?<end>
segment.target: ::He raises his weapon.:: Thought ya could fool me, punk?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade][Hacking]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Came here to check out the slowdowns you've been experiencing lately. Now considering you're running advanced military software on that crappy-looking laptop... Eh, could be anything: CPU overheating, hard drive issues, viruses or just some background app doing crap. Anyway, the sooner I start the sooner I get 'er back up to full speed.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade][Hacking]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Came here to check out the slowdowns you've been experiencing lately. Now considering you're running advanced military software on that crappy-looking laptop... Eh, could be anything: CPU overheating, hard drive issues, viruses or just some background app doing crap. Anyway, the sooner I start the sooner I get 'er back up to full speed.<end>

segment.source: Not so fast! ::He raises his weapon.::<end>
segment.target: Not so fast! ::He raises his weapon.::<end>

segment.source: ::Feel the bottle.:: Got a colder one?<end>
segment.target: ::Feel the bottle.:: Got a colder one?<end>

segment.source: Colder? ::He presses the bottle against his cheek.:: It's as cold as freakin' cryogel!<end>
segment.target: Colder? ::He presses the bottle against his cheek.:: It's as cold as freakin' cryogel!<end>

segment.source:
::He stares at you, and soon frowns.::
Ya almost fooled me, ya crapper! ::He lunges at you with his knife.::<end>
segment.target:
::He stares at you, and soon frowns.::
Ya almost fooled me, ya crapper! ::He lunges at you with his knife.::<end>

segment.source:
::He hands you the brew.::
So, uh... how's it goin'? Figured out what's buggin' it?<end>
segment.target:
::He hands you the brew.::
So, uh... how's it goin'? Figured out what's buggin' it?<end>

segment.source: As a matter of fact yes, yes I did.<end>
segment.target: As a matter of fact yes, yes I did.<end>

segment.source: Awesome. So... ya fixed it, right?<end>
segment.target: Awesome. So... ya fixed it, right?<end>

segment.source: ::He smiles.:: Hey, that's awesome! Ya know, that thing's, uh... really important.<end>
segment.target: ::He smiles.:: Hey, that's awesome! Ya know, that thing's, uh... really important.<end>

segment.source: I know, I know. That's why I came all the way here, buddy. ::Smile.::<end>
segment.target: I know, I know. That's why I came all the way here, buddy. ::Smile.::<end>

segment.source: I certanly did. Now I really...<end>
segment.target: I certanly did. Now I really...<end>

segment.source: Hey, why ain't it glowin' no more? Them lights used to be always on.<end>
segment.target: Hey, why ain't it glowin' no more? Them lights used to be always on.<end>

segment.source: It's rebooting. They'll be on in a couple of minutes.<end>
segment.target: It's rebooting. They'll be on in a couple of minutes.<end>

segment.source: Uh... okay. I'll tell Mike whatcha did.<end>
segment.target: Uh... okay. I'll tell Mike whatcha did.<end>

segment.source: Heh, it's even runnin' a lot quieter than before.<end>
segment.target: Heh, it's even runnin' a lot quieter than before.<end>

segment.source: Sure is. Now I really gotta go. So long.<end>
segment.target: Sure is. Now I really gotta go. So long.<end>

segment.source:
Yeah, yeah, bye.
Can't wait to hear what Mike's gonna say...<end>
segment.target:
Yeah, yeah, bye.
Can't wait to hear what Mike's gonna say...<end>

segment.source: Y-ya broke it, ya dumb crapper! ::He grabs his head.:: Do ya even g-g-gotta clue whatcha did, ya... ya...!<end>
segment.target: Y-ya broke it, ya dumb crapper! ::He grabs his head.:: Do ya even g-g-gotta clue whatcha did, ya... ya...!<end>

segment.source: They were drawing way too much power, so I switched them off. They were causing the slowdowns, in fact.<end>
segment.target: They were drawing way too much power, so I switched them off. They were causing the slowdowns, in fact.<end>

segment.source: ::[Electronics] or [Hacking]:: Had to switch them off. They were drawing way too much power, and the aging power supply unit was struggling to deliver the needed voltage, which in turn raises the current so that the power can remain constant, which in turn raises the temperature due to resistance, which finally results in the cpu slowing down as to avoid damage.<end>
segment.target: ::[Electronics] or [Hacking]:: Had to switch them off. They were drawing way too much power, and the aging power supply unit was struggling to deliver the needed voltage, which in turn raises the current so that the power can remain constant, which in turn raises the temperature due to resistance, which finally results in the cpu slowing down as to avoid damage.<end>

segment.source: They'll turn on in a few minutes.<end>
segment.target: They'll turn on in a few minutes.<end>

segment.source: Who cares about the lights, man?<end>
segment.target: Who cares about the lights, man?<end>

segment.source:
::He nods a few times in understanding, as if you've told him something profound.::
<end>
segment.target:
::He nods a few times in understanding, as if you've told him something profound.::
<end>

segment.source: Yeah... uh... I'll letcha do yer thing.<end>
segment.target: Yeah... uh... I'll letcha do yer thing.<end>

segment.source:
Well, ya better shut up 'n' do yers, alright.
Ungrateful bastard...<end>
segment.target:
Well, ya better shut up 'n' do yers, alright.
Ungrateful bastard...<end>

segment.source: What the-- Hold it right there!<end>
segment.target: What the-- Hold it right there!<end>

segment.source: Anyone ever told ya ya, uh... look a lot like the Invictus?<end>
segment.target: Anyone ever told ya ya, uh... look a lot like the Invictus?<end>

segment.source: Heard about the raid? Them pirates are at it again!<end>
segment.target: Heard about the raid? Them pirates are at it again!<end>

segment.source: Heard about, uh... what the pirates did to Protectorate? Holy pentapus!<end>
segment.target: Heard about, uh... what the pirates did to Protectorate? Holy pentapus!<end>

segment.source: First time seein' you 'ere. Whaddya want?<end>
segment.target: First time seein' you 'ere. Whaddya want?<end>

segment.source: Now who are you 'n' whaddya want?<end>
segment.target: Now who are you 'n' whaddya want?<end>

segment.source: ::[Perception]:: All the wiring seems to be leading here. Is that the power room?<end>
segment.target: ::[Perception]:: All the wiring seems to be leading here. Is that the power room?<end>

segment.source: That's right. Now answer my question.<end>
segment.target: That's right. Now answer my question.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intelligence]:: All the wiring seems to be leading here. Is that the power room?<end>
segment.target: ::[Intelligence]:: All the wiring seems to be leading here. Is that the power room?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). We're doin' some work on the turrets and need to turn 'em off for about half an hour or so.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). We're doin' some work on the turrets and need to turn 'em off for about half an hour or so.<end>

segment.source: Just go in 'n' do yer thing.<end>
segment.target: Just go in 'n' do yer thing.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade][Electronics]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). We got some turrets workin' sluggish, so I came 'ere to turn off the power so we could try an' figure out what's causin' the low voltage. The network's not overloaded, we checked that first, an' wirin' looks good. Frankly, I'm just hopin' it's not the bloody transformer.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade][Electronics]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). We got some turrets workin' sluggish, so I came 'ere to turn off the power so we could try an' figure out what's causin' the low voltage. The network's not overloaded, we checked that first, an' wirin' looks good. Frankly, I'm just hopin' it's not the bloody transformer.<end>

segment.source: I ain't diggin' nuthin' of whatcha sayin'.<end>
segment.target: I ain't diggin' nuthin' of whatcha sayin'.<end>

segment.source: Hey! HEY! Ya ain't supposed to be 'ere!<end>
segment.target: Hey! HEY! Ya ain't supposed to be 'ere!<end>

segment.source: Hey you - *you*, come 'ere. ::He takes a good look at you.:: Haven't seen yer face 'round 'ere before.<end>
segment.target: Hey you - *you*, come 'ere. ::He takes a good look at you.:: Haven't seen yer face 'round 'ere before.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Been told you $(#folks needed an extra pair of hands/boys needed some help) around here, so here I am earning myself some shinies.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: I'm the new $(#guy/girl). Been told you $(#folks needed an extra pair of hands/boys needed some help) around here, so here I am earning myself some shinies.<end>

segment.source: Well... carry on, then. In case ya haven't been told: Steer clear of the northwestern section. That's off-limits, dig?<end>
segment.target: Well... carry on, then. In case ya haven't been told: Steer clear of the northwestern section. That's off-limits, dig?<end>

segment.source: Silas sent me. I got something for the boss.<end>
segment.target: Silas sent me. I got something for the boss.<end>

segment.source:
Silas? Silas is dead, ya dumb bastard!
WE GOT AN INTRUDER!<end>
segment.target:
Silas? Silas is dead, ya dumb bastard!
WE GOT AN INTRUDER!<end>

segment.source: For the rigmaster? Give it 'ere. I'll bring it to 'im.<end>
segment.target: For the rigmaster? Give it 'ere. I'll bring it to 'im.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: If this were intended for your grubby fingers to defile, you would've known by now.<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate]:: If this were intended for your grubby fingers to defile, you would've known by now.<end>

segment.source: Hey, ya watch yer tongue, you!<end>
segment.target: Hey, ya watch yer tongue, you!<end>

segment.source:
Okay, okay, ya can go. Go on through.
::He mutters to himself.:: Bloody bastards never tellin' me nothin'...<end>
segment.target:
Okay, okay, ya can go. Go on through.
::He mutters to himself.:: Bloody bastards never tellin' me nothin'...<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: No can do, man. I was told not to show, much less hand this over to anyone but the rigmaster himself.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: No can do, man. I was told not to show, much less hand this over to anyone but the rigmaster himself.<end>

segment.source: Sorry, but I really gotta rush.<end>
segment.target: Sorry, but I really gotta rush.<end>
